editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: HFM is a legit, FCA-regulated broker with 15 years of operation and six licences spanning four continents — a regulatory footprint that genuinely sets it apart from the offshore-only crowd in emerging markets. The Pro account at $5 all-in per lot on EUR/USD is competitive pricing for a commission-free model in 2026, and the $0 minimum deposit makes it accessible to traders who cannot meet IC Markets' $200 barrier. But the decision to stop onboarding new EEA retail clients in Q3 2025 is a significant signal that deserves attention — a CySEC-licenced broker choosing to exit the EU acquisition pipeline is unusual. Most global clients land on the FSA Seychelles entity where 1:2000 leverage is available and compensation protection is zero. The FCA licence genuinely protects UK clients with FSCS coverage, making HFM one of the few brokers in this tier where UK traders get real regulatory backstop. Malaysia and Ukraine warnings, plus clone firm alerts on the FCA register, add noise but do not trigger kill-switch territory. A mid-tier broker with one genuinely strong card — the FCA licence — and a lot of emerging market volume riding on offshore rails.
